question: In which of the following clinical contexts is NOT the use of intravenous gammaglobulins recommended?

options.opa: Substitute treatment in humoral immunodeficiencies (defect in the formation of antibodies).
options.opb: Prevention of monoclonal gammopathy of uncertain significance (MGUS).
options.opd: Management of inflammatory / autoimmune neurological pathologies (Sd. Guillain-Barré, multiple sclerosis).
options.ope: Therapeutic management of immune thrombocyanic purpura (ITP).
